nodes.title:
HOW TO USE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
API KEY
Paste the WaveSpeed key once in the masked field.
The saved workflow never contains the raw key.

MODEL
Choose one route in the MATRIX WaveSpeed API node.

MONEY SAFETY
LIVE is OFF by default. No paid request runs until enabled.

REFERENCES
R01 is required. Toggle R02–R08 in the rgthree panel.
R02–R04 start enabled; R05–R08 start bypassed.

SHOTS
F01 starts enabled; all other shots start bypassed.
Use the row panel or the switch above one shot card.

RE-RUN
Change one prompt to request only that image again.
